```yaml
name: PR Preview Deployment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  deploy-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Get PR number
        id: pr
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get changed documentation files
        id: changed_files
        run: |
          python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py
          echo "changed_files=$(cat changed_files.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build documentation
        run: |
          mike deploy --update-aliases --push pr/${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }} dev

      - name: Deploy to preview
        run: |
          mike deploy --update-aliases --push pr/${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }} dev

      - name: Post PR comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const { number } = context.issue;
            const previewUrl = `https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${number}/`;
            
            // Check if there's an existing comment from this action
            const comments = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: number
            });
            
            const existingComment = comments.data.find(comment => 
              comment.body.includes('Preview deployed to')
            );
            
            if (existingComment) {
              // Update existing comment
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existingComment.id,
                body: `Preview deployed to: ${previewUrl}\n\n[View documentation](https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${number}/)`
              });
            } else {
              // Create new comment
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: number,
                body: `Preview deployed to: ${previewUrl}\n\n[View documentation](https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${number}/)`
              });
            }

  cleanup-preview:
    needs: deploy-preview
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Cleanup preview
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          mike delete pr/$PR_NUMBER
          mike deploy --update-aliases dev
```
